The affix ष्ट्रन् with in the sense of instrument, comes after the verbs 1. दाप 'to cut' 2. नी 'to lead' 3. शस् 'to hurt' 4. यु 'to join' 5. युज् 'to join' 6. स्तु 'to praise' 7. तुद् 'to inflict pain' 8. सि 'to bind' 9. सिच् 'to sprinkle' 10. मिह् 'to urine' 11. पत् 'to fall' 12. दश् 'to bite' 13. नह् 'to bind'

Terms: ष्ट्रन्

The affix ङीप् comes in the feminine after a बहुव्रीहि समास beginning with a Numeral and ending with the words 1. दामन् 'a rope' and 2. हायन 'a year'.

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीप्

The affix छ (ईय) comes without changing the sense after दामिनि etc. and after six warrior-stocks called त्रिगर्त षष्ठा।

Terms: छ (ईय)

For the vowel of the root दम्भ् there is substituted इ as well as ई before सन् of the Desiderative when it begins with स्।

Terms: Long ई
